rules.name: delegated rulemaking
rules.legal_function: Congress requires an executive actor to write implementing rules.
rules.human_operation: An agency or official must write the detailed rules that make this part work.
context_requirements: Identify the official or agency.

rules.name: delegated determination

rules.name: strike and insert amendment
rules.legal_function: The bill edits existing law by removing old text and replacing or adding new text.
rules.human_operation: Congress changes an existing rule rather than stating the whole new rule from scratch.
context_requirements: Retrieve the pre-amendment text.
Resolve what the edited words or numbers mean in their statutory context.

rules.name: override clause
rules.legal_function: This clause operates despite another rule that would otherwise apply.
rules.human_operation: This rule overrides another rule for the situation described here.
context_requirements: Identify the rule being overridden.
Determine the scope and duration of the override.

rules.name: subject-to condition
rules.legal_function: This rule is subordinate to, limited by, or conditioned on another rule.
rules.human_operation: This only works within the limits of another rule.
context_requirements: Identify the controlling rule or condition.
Determine what happens if the condition is not met.

rules.name: exception cross-reference
rules.legal_function: The apparent rule has an exception defined elsewhere.
rules.human_operation: There is an exception, and the reader must follow it before treating this as the whole rule.

Determine who or what the exception removes from the general rule.

rules.name: legal classification
rules.legal_function: The statute assigns a legal classification that may differ from ordinary-language identity.
rules.human_operation: For this law, Congress tells us to count something as—or not as—something else.
context_requirements: Identify the thing being classified.
Identify the legal category and the consequences of that classification.

rules.name: deeming rule
rules.legal_function: The statute creates a legal assumption or status for a defined purpose.
rules.human_operation: The law tells us to treat a fact or status as legally true for this purpose.
context_requirements: Identify what is being deemed true.
Identify the purpose and downstream legal consequence.

rules.name: local scope definition
rules.legal_function: The statement defines or modifies meaning only within a specified statutory scope.
rules.human_operation: This definition or rule applies only in the part of the law named here.
context_requirements: Identify the exact scope.
Do not generalize the definition outside that scope.

rules.name: effective date
rules.legal_function: The statute specifies when a change begins to govern conduct, transactions, or tax years.
rules.human_operation: This tells us when the change starts applying.

Check for separate transition or expiration rules.

rules.name: redesignation

rules.name: authorization

rules.name: appropriation
